ground_truth_policy: Never include ground truth in model prompts or snapshot JSON.
evidence_rule: Use the complete frozen snapshot JSON verbatim as the evidence payload for every model.
prompt_rule: Replace only {evidence_json}; all task instructions and JSON schemas remain identical across models.

generation_settings.thinking_mode: Use each model's supported explicit setting consistently.
generation_settings.temperature: Set once before the pilot and freeze for the full benchmark.
generation_settings.top_p: Set once before the pilot and freeze for the full benchmark.
generation_settings.max_output_tokens: Set once before the pilot and freeze for the full benchmark.

pilot_requirements: Include representative alert-originated and complaint-originated cases.
Test JSON validity on every task response.
Test evidence references against snapshot record IDs.
Record raw response, latency, generated tokens, prompt tokens, GPU memory and errors.
Do not tune prompts using pilot results that would leak ground-truth labels.
